lena: Heads-up: infra is merging gateway schema v2 today. This changes the internal route metadata and how SDKs surface route hints. Need a quick sync on client impact.

samir: Which headers/fields change? Is this just a rename or structural?

lena: New schema replaces X-Route-Policy + X-Route-Tags with a single header `X-Route-Meta: {"route_key":"...", "policy":"...", "ver":2}`. SDKs currently expect flat strings so parsing will break.

alex_g: Oof. Python & TS SDKs parse header as string; Go uses map[string]string. We'll break older clients unless we shim.

maria: Proposal: SDKs auto-detect ver<=1 and convert to new shape. Add env var `RD_GATEWAY_SCHEMA=2` to opt in. Emit a deprecation warning when we see legacy headers.

samir: Agree. Also need a console toggle to enable canary (5-10%) so customers can opt-in before full flip. Devex/console UX needs a simple toggle + telemetry breakdown.

devops-bot: Deploy triggered: gateway/schema-v2 -> canary 1/100 @ 3460012355 :rocket:

lena: Telemetry ask: update routing dashboard to show `route_meta_v2` vs `legacy_hint` and a metric for shim conversions. Keep sampling (1%) for full payloads to avoid storage blowup.

ryan: Tests we need: header roundtrip, fallback path where SDK sees legacy header -> new internal call, and latency regression <2ms on parsing. Add these to CI matrix across Py/TS/Go.

maria: Release plan sketch: ship SDK minor with shim + opt-in env next week, warn and deprecate old parsing in ~3 months, full flip in ~4 months. Docs PR + changelog by EOD.

alex_g: I'll open PRs for python and ts today. Go needs an interface change for typed route meta — I'll add a compatibility layer and mark it in the changelog; may need a major bump if API surface changes.

lena: Action items: alex_g PRs, samir console toggle, ryan tests, maria docs. I'll file the RFC and JIRA epic. @devex please coordinate release notes. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: JIRA EPIC created: RDG-1234 gateway schema migration. Assigned to devex/eng-platform.
